title: French Almond Crumble Tart
description: A delicious French dessert featuring a buttery almond crumble topping on a flaky pastry crust.
instructions: 2. Roll out the all-purpose flour to form a circle for the crust.
3. Place the rolled out dough into a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
4. Press the dough evenly into the corners of the pan.
5. In a separate bowl, combine the softened butter, almond flour, granulated sugar, and a pinch of salt.
6. Add the eggs to the almond flour mixture and mix until a dough forms.
7. Press the dough evenly into the crust.
8. Sprinkle the crumble topping over the dough.
9. Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
10. Allow the tart to cool completely before serving.
